content: {"like":["Enjoys music parodies that faithfully emulate iconic bands in period‑accurate costumes","Values authentic period design and set pieces in 1960s‑style sci‑fi and fantasy series","Prefers live‑action musical performances that showcase strong acting over vocal perfection","Appreciates high‑quality opera recordings with superb vocalists and detailed stage design","Loves restored classic comedies with added behind‑the‑scenes material and insightful commentary"],"dislike":["Dislikes American casts that feel like improv rather than accurate impersonations","Criticizes live‑singing musical films for uneven vocal performances and poor musical execution","Finds political commentary in classic films forced and biased","Rejects series that rely on gimmicks and unresolved plotlines over substantive storytelling","Disapproves of films with excessive or gratuitous violence and crude language"]}
